messages:
Mia Chen: quick sync — after the q4b quant bring-up we saw a regression cluster on a subset of prompts. thinking we need a short canary corpus refresh + de-dup scrub before rolling more widely. who can own the collection side and who can own the labeling handoff? :eyes:
Samir Patel: I can take the collection scrub. ran a neighborhood-sim pass overnight, ~12% near-duplicates at 0.85 sim. I think bumping threshold to 0.87 will cut false positives but keep recall. sharing hash dump in the thread in a sec. :small_airplane:
Jonah Lee: I can do the canary composition (replace + augment). my plan: 400 new diverse prompts, 100 deterministic anchors, 50 adversarial-style edgecases. will sample across locales and length buckets.
Priya Rao: label ops note — current external labeler capacity is ~200 completed judgments/day if we parallelize batches. we also need a golden refresh because some anchor labels are stale (last labeled 8 months ago).
Samir Patel: putting my dedupe command here so ops can reproduce:```
python tools/dedupe/pairwise_hash.py \
  --input s3://redwood-raw/prompts/q4b-raw.jsonl \
  --threshold 0.87 \
  --out s3://redwood-curation/q4b-scrubbed-3180001111.jsonl
```
Mia Chen: @Samir thanks. @Priya do we have slack for adding a mini-golden task of 150 items to the internal QA pool? that should let us validate model delta quickly. timeline: can we aim for dataset ready for labeling by EOD Thu?
Priya Rao: EOD Thu is tight but doable if we cut the initial labeling scope to 300 items (canary + anchors). i'll schedule two labeler shifts and enable fast-track QC. will drop assignment spreadsheet link once ready. :white_check_mark:
Jonah Lee: quick note re evals — please run the usual paired-metric diff (BLEU/ROUGE/semantic-sim) and also the new hallucination regression probe we added last quarter. small script to run locally:```
# run paired eval
python eval/pairwise_delta.py --model old_model --model q4b-quant --promptset canary_corpus.jsonl --metrics semantic,bleu,regression_probe
```
LabelBot: automated-golden-audit: completed 3180001111 audit run. 93/150 anchors remain passing consistency threshold. Report: https://redwood.infra/reports/3180001111-canary-audit :robot_face:
Samir Patel: linking the dedupe report and sample list here: s3://redwood-curation/reports/dedupe-3180001111.csv — highlights: most duplicates were short-instruction paraphrases, and a small cluster of templated system prompts. recommend dropping templated ones but keep paraphrase variations for recall testing.
Mia Chen: decision point: drop templated repeats, keep paraphrases. proceed with 0.87 dedupe threshold. action items: Samir scrub, Jonah assemble canary, Priya schedule labeling and golden refresh. tagging owners in thread. :clipboard:
Priya Rao: ack — I'll also add a quick labeler note: include "is-template" flag to help downstream filters. CSV schema: prompt_id,label,is_template,notes.
Samir Patel: will push scrubbed JSON to the curation bucket and open a PR for the sample manifest. ETA ~ 6 hours.
Mia Chen: perfect. if anyone finds a surprising regression patch the evals, ping here and we'll pause rollout. thanks team! :thumbsup:
